description: Recording time axis (t=0 is the start of the RECORDED segment, i.e. after the burn-in period has already elapsed). Shared by every trial.
Observed (noisy) excitatory population activity for each trial.
Observed (noisy) inhibitory population activity for each trial.
Stimulus condition index for each row of E_obs/I_obs. Join with stimulus_protocol.csv.

Commanded external drive to the inhibitory population for this condition (the experiment's control variable -- analogous to a pharmacological or optogenetic manipulation of inhibitory tone). This value IS given; the model's other parameters are not.
Number of repeated trials recorded at this condition.
Duration simulated (stochastically) and DISCARDED before recording began, to let the population settle onto its stationary fluctuation distribution.
'fit' = intended for parameter estimation. 'holdout' = reserved for validation; do not use these conditions when fitting model parameters.
KNOWN (disclosed) measurement-noise standard deviation from an independent instrument calibration. See noise_calibration.json for details.
